description: This source file defines the class 'FieldSourcer', which extends ASM's 'FieldVisitor'. It is responsible for generating Java source code that represents field declarations based on class file information. The class processes annotations, attributes, and writes out field type, name, and semicolon, supporting signature processing if available.

classes.name: FieldSourcer
classes.description: A class extending ASM's FieldVisitor to generate Java source code for a field definition, including annotations, attributes, and signature processing.

methods.name: FieldSourcer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FieldSourcer with output, access flags, name, description, and signature.

methods.name: visitAnnotation
methods.description: Processes an annotation on the field, writing its descriptor to output and returning an AnnotationSourcer.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Handles non-standard attributes by writing a comment with attribute type.

methods.name: visitEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the field declaration by writing type, name, and terminating with a semicolon, using signature information if available.
